sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Khaled joined an English practice group. The group asked everyone to introduce themselves and speak about real interests and plans. Khaled said, “Let me introduce myself.” His friend replied, “My name is Khaled.” Khaled said, “I come from Saudi Arabia.” His friend replied, “I currently live in Riyadh.” Khaled said, “I am interested in technology.” His friend replied, “I studied artificial intelligence.” Khaled said, “I enjoy learning new things.” His friend replied, “I want to improve my English.” Khaled said, “I practice a little every day.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Khaled said, “I usually study in the evening.” His friend replied, “I like meeting new people.” Khaled said, “I am a curious person.” His friend replied, “I try to be patient with myself.” Khaled said, “I learn from my mistakes.” His friend replied, “I sometimes need more time.” Khaled said, “I am comfortable asking questions.” His friend replied, “My family means a lot to me.” Khaled said, “I keep in touch with my friends.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Khaled said, “In my free time, I exercise.” His friend replied, “I also enjoy cycling.” Khaled said, “I like listening to music.” His friend replied, “I prefer calm places.” Khaled said, “I am working toward a clear goal.” His friend replied, “My goal is to speak confidently.” Khaled said, “I want to understand everyday conversations.” His friend replied, “I do not expect instant progress.” Khaled said, “Small steps make a difference.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Khaled said, “I am proud when I improve.” His friend replied, “I can describe my background.” Khaled said, “I can talk about my interests.” His friend replied, “What would you like to know about me?” Khaled said, “Please feel free to ask.” His friend replied, “That is a little about me.” Khaled said, “Now, tell me about yourself.” They felt more confident after practising together.
